MainHero.headline: I build maintainable and scalable software products that solve real problems.
MainHero.description: Software Engineer behind GatoArtStudio. I develop digital products, tools, and systems — from architecture to production.

MainAbout.title: Software Engineer
MainAbout.p1: I'm Hervis Cortes, creator of GatoArtStudio, a personal brand from which I develop software products and systems for clients and companies.
MainAbout.p2: My work is focused on building maintainable solutions, ready to evolve over time. I've worked on web applications, desktop tools, automations, and Minecraft ecosystems, covering everything from architecture and development to continuous delivery and deployment.
MainAbout.p3: My approach centers on quality, maintainability, and building products capable of growing alongside business needs.

minemuHostingWeb.title: Minemu Hosting
minemuHostingWeb.description: Minemu Hosting's main website, where they offer hosting services for Minecraft and have a network for their community.
minemuHostingWeb.problem: The hosting service needed a modern web presence that reflected their brand and integrated with their Minecraft community network.
minemuHostingWeb.solution: A full website built with React, Astro, and TailwindCSS, deployed through automated CI/CD pipelines using Docker and GitHub Actions.
minemuHostingWeb.result: A professional platform that unifies their service offering and community experience.

kailandWeb.title: Kailand
kailandWeb.description: This website has several sections that allow Kailand users to access social networks, download the launcher, and explore a wiki with server information.
kailandWeb.problem: The Minecraft community needed a centralized experience with their own tools to access, explore, and engage with the server ecosystem.
kailandWeb.solution: A web platform built with React, Astro, and TailwindCSS, integrated with the launcher and custom server resources.
kailandWeb.result: Greater integration between services and a better experience for users across the entire Kailand ecosystem.

appGatoBot.title: GatoBot
appGatoBot.description: Discord bot in Python with an automated deployment system. When the project starts, a Discord bot, a REST API server, a static web service, and a Cloudflare tunnel are deployed to provide web and API access.

botView.title: BotView
botView.description: This tool allows you to generate views on your videos on YouTube and TikTok.

kailandLauncher.title: Kailand Launcher
kailandLauncher.description: A launcher for Minecraft Java developed in Python with Flet. It's fully automated, so the user doesn't need to install anything. The launcher pre-configures and installs everything and includes a settings section and a client-side mods section for customizing the game.

authGatun.title: AuthGatun 2FA
authGatun.description: 2FA application for Windows, Linux, and macOS, using C# and Avalonia UI.

muneCratPlugin.title: MuneCraft Plugin
muneCratPlugin.description: MuneCrat-Plugin is a comprehensive Minecraft server plugin designed for the MuñeCraft community server. It integrates Minecraft with Discord authentication, provides custom gameplay features, and offers administrative tools for server management.

kailandPluginMinecraft.title: Kailand Plugin
kailandPluginMinecraft.description: This plugin allows the server to only authorize one Minecraft account to enter the Kailand server by using an API that receives user data from the launcher.
